subject: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — availability & attendees
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@hospitech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — availability & attendees

Hi Elena — thanks again for the productive discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next step:

Recap (1 line each):
- Current pain: inconsistent inference latency and high cost at peak.
- Immediate goal: baseline production latency targets and a path to predictable throughput.
- Success criteria: <100ms p50 for short queries; predictable unit cost within 20% of target.

Next step: schedule a technical deep dive (60–90 minutes) with our ML/Infra engineers to walk through: model topology and ops, dataset characteristics, expected concurrency, and recommended serving configs (batching, KV caching, quantization trade-offs).

Proposed windows (PST):
1) Tue 6/8 — 10:00–11:15am
2) Wed 6/9 — 1:30–2:45pm
3) Fri 6/11 — 3:00–4:15pm

Please tell me which of these work (or propose up to two alternatives) and who from your engineering team should join (ideally one ML lead + one infra/platform engineer). I’ve attached the post-call notes and a draft mutual-action-plan that we can iterate on in the session.

Attendees suggested on our side: Marcus (principal infra engineer) and Karthik (solutions/ML infra). If any other Redwood folks are needed, we’ll add them.

Agenda draft for the session (we’ll finalize once we lock time):
- 5m introductions & goals
- 15m current architecture & dataset characteristics (you)
- 25–30m inference serving configuration options (our recommendations + tradeoffs)
- 10–15m ops/runbook & SLA discussion
- 10m action items & mutual action plan next steps

Thanks — I’ll hold the windows tentatively for 24 hours.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: Hospitech-postcall-notes.pdf (summary), Hospitech-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan stub)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@hospitech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@hospitech.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 18:26:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — availability & attendees

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligned with what we need.

We can do Tue 6/8 10:00am PST (works for our ML lead and infra), OR Fri 6/11 3:00pm PST if that helps with internal schedules — prefer Tue if Marcus/Karthik are available.

Attendees from Hospitech: 
- Elena Ruiz (Head of Product)
- Miguel Santos (Platform/Infra lead) — cc’d
- Priya Nair (ML Lead, will confirm if she can make Tue morning)

A couple quick asks before the deep dive: 
- Can you confirm whether you need a small sample of the production prompt set and a representative tail-latency log? We can share sanitized examples.
- Miguel: we’ll want to discuss data residency & retention briefly; can Redwood share the default retention window and whether customer-managed KMS is required for Private deployments?

We’ll confirm Priya and any other attendees first thing Monday.

—Elena
Elena Ruiz | Head of Product, Hospitech
elena@hospitech.com

On attachments: the MAP looks useful — happy to iterate that in the session.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@hospitech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — availability & attendees

Elena — terrific, let’s lock Tue 6/8 10:00–11:15am PST (75 minutes). I’ll send a calendar invite shortly.

Quick answers to your asks: 
- Yes, sanitized prompt samples and a short tail-latency export will be very helpful. We don’t need production PII — a shuffled/sampled set is perfect. Marcus, Karthik: can you confirm the exact file formats you prefer (CSV/JSON) and any size limits?
- Data retention & KMS: for our hosted API, default retention for logs/metrics is 90 days; for Private we support customer-managed KMS (HSM/KMS integrations) — we’ll have a short slide in the session covering deployment choices.

Marcus / Karthik — can you 1) confirm you can join Tue 10am PST and 2) flag any prep items you want prior to the meeting? If we need to shift to the Fri slot I’ll propose that as backup.

Thanks — invite and draft agenda coming.

Marissa
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: Hospitech-MAP-v1.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@hospitech.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@hospitech.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — availability & attendees

Locked and on my calendar. A couple quick prep notes from the infra side so the session is high signal: 

Prep for Hospitech (recommended):
- Send a small sample of ~200–500 prompts (JSONL preferred) including a few long-tail cases and a note on average sequence length.
- Tail latency export for the last 2 weeks (p50/p95/p99) with concurrency context if available (CSV ok).
- Typical concurrency expectations (spikes per minute and steady-state QPS).

Redwood will prepare (we’ll share before the call):
- Short faqs on default retention and KMS options (1 slide)
- A quick sizing sketch (GPU types and expected token/sec per config) with cost ballpark ranges
- Decision checklist: when to use Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private for performance/regulatory needs

Updated agenda (75m):
- 5m introductions & goals  
- 15m Hospitech environment & dataset (Priya/Miguel)
- 30m Serving options & sizing walk-through (Marcus + Karthik)
- 15m Ops/runbook, SLAs, retention & security (short)
- 10m Action items & MAP alignment

I’ll drop a ics invite and a short prep note to Elena and Miguel including the preferred file formats.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
